explication: Diffusion Studio is a code-driven video editor built for both agents and people. The main workflow is: an agent or user opens a project folder, edits its JSX composition or manipulates the visual editor, then inspects media and renders the result. The web editor mounts compositions into an ECS-backed runtime; the desktop app exposes editing and media tools to agents through MCP and CLI interfaces. The README documents these product-level links; sampled source confirms the engine’s runtime systems and the desktop MCP server’s dispatch. Several subsystems are represented by their existing directories because their implementation files were not sampled.
